RDS in Dublin Photo by PRESS ASSOCIATION. Date of picture: Wednesday December 5, 2018. Jeweller Pierce Healy was chosen by Jackson to design the rings for his new film Mortal Engines which opens in cinemas this week (Brian Lawless/PA)
Pierce Healy has created 10 rings for Lord Of The Rings director Peter Jackson’s new movie Mortal Engines which opens in cinemas on Wednesday (PA Graphics)
He said creating the rings was an opportunity to “exercise my imagination and my skills...I had total freedom to design things...it was hard not to be influenced by Tolkein of course”.
He said he was thrilled to be working on the film since he is a fan of Jackson's work.
“I was a huge fan of the director, since 1997.”
